nodes.label: B+ Tree Height h = ceil(log_F N)
nodes.norm_label: b+ tree height h = ceil(log_f n)
nodes.rationale: high fan-out (~100) keeps trees shallow so lookups need ~3 I/Os

nodes.label: Binary Search on Sorted File
nodes.rationale: log2 B cost, but maintaining sorted order on insert is O(B), prohibitively expensive

nodes.label: Clustered (Primary) Index
nodes.rationale: range scans read contiguous blocks; at most one per table

nodes.label: Doubly Linked Leaf Pages
nodes.rationale: enables efficient range scans without traversing internal nodes

nodes.label: Storage Hierarchy & I/O Cost Model
nodes.rationale: I/O cost dominates execution time in RDBMS

nodes.label: Unclustered (Secondary) Index
nodes.rationale: each match may need a random I/O

nodes.label: Precedence (Serialization) Graph
nodes.rationale: schedule is conflict serializable iff precedence graph is acyclic

nodes.label: Strict 2PL
nodes.rationale: holding X locks until commit/abort guarantees recoverability and avoids cascading aborts

nodes.label: Assessment Blueprint Matrix
nodes.rationale: maps CLOs, Bloom levels, topics and item types to marks; every CLO must get non-zero marks

nodes.label: Cognitive Balance Rule
nodes.rationale: Bloom mark distribution must match with zero percentage-point difference

nodes.label: Empirical Equivalence Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: blueprint parity is guaranteed by constraint validation, but empirical equivalence needs post-hoc statistical analysis

nodes.label: External Moderation Protocol
nodes.rationale: moderator reviews Version A and B with solutions, verifies all review flags resolved, digital sign-off before printing

nodes.label: Structural Parity (Main vs Repeat)
nodes.rationale: repeat paper must match main in marks, duration, format proportions, CLO weighting

nodes.label: Item Non-Duplication (Zero Reuse Rule)
nodes.rationale: no main-sitting item may be reused in the repeat sitting

nodes.label: Agent Trace (runs/{runId} steps)
nodes.rationale: Every agent step is recorded to make agent behaviour visible, which is critical for judging.

nodes.label: Google Cloud AI Builder Cup 2026
nodes.rationale: Judging weights (Technical Merit 40%, Impact 25%, Innovation 25%, UX 10%) drive the priority order: reliable demo, visible Gemini/agent use, clean UX.

nodes.label: Frontend AGENTS.md (Next.js agent rules)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes; read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code.

nodes.label: Agent Hosting Decision (Cloud Run first, Agent Engine later)
nodes.norm_label: agent hosting decision (cloud run first, agent engine later)
nodes.rationale: Running ADK agents inside FastAPI is fastest to debug; Agent Engine added behind a flag so the demo never depends on a fragile path.

nodes.label: ADR 010: BigQuery Telemetry & Dual Agent Engine Runtime
nodes.norm_label: adr 010: bigquery telemetry & dual agent engine runtime
nodes.rationale: Quantifiable ROI telemetry with in-memory fallback; orchestrator auto-falls back to local ADK if Agent Engine unreachable.

nodes.label: DECISION-002: Multi-Agent Architecture with ADK
nodes.rationale: In-process hosting gives low latency and easy debugging; Agent Engine available via flag.

nodes.label: DECISION-006: Local & Offline Resilience (in-memory fallbacks)
nodes.rationale: Tests and CI run without GCP billing or network dependencies.

nodes.label: DECISION-001: Model Selection & google-genai SDK
nodes.rationale: gemini-2.5-flash default for latency/cost; REVIEWER_MODEL configurable to pro; Pydantic response_schema guarantees valid JSON.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-loop Checkpoints
nodes.rationale: Checkpoints implemented as separate API calls resuming the run rather than blocking waits.

nodes.label: DECISION-004: Region and Service Locality
nodes.rationale: Core services in asia-southeast1; Document AI in us/eu and Vertex AI Search global due to regional availability.

nodes.label: CS2040 Database Systems Seed Course
nodes.rationale: Past-paper questions deliberately seeded so the duplicate detector fires in the demo.

nodes.label: Equivalence Report (Guaranteed vs Estimated)
nodes.rationale: Matching blueprints do not prove equal difficulty; empirical comparability requires student response data.

nodes.label: Academic Equivalence Bounds (structural vs empirical)
nodes.rationale: Structural parity does not prove empirical parity; requires post-exam IRT data.

nodes.label: Difficulty Balance Objective
nodes.rationale: Minimising inter-version difficulty gap so parallel cohorts face comparable challenge.

nodes.label: Multi-Version Paper Assembly Solver Documentation v1.0

nodes.label: Determinism Rule (no LLM arithmetic)
nodes.rationale: Totals, blueprint validation, assembly and statistics are Python code; LLMs only emit Pydantic-validated JSON with up to 2 retries.

nodes.label: Strict Grounding Rules
nodes.rationale: Answer only from retrieved passages; declare insufficient evidence rather than invent past exam occurrences.

nodes.label: 2.5x Candidate Pool Multiplier
nodes.rationale: Oversupply gives room for reviewer rejection, difficulty calibration and non-overlapping multi-version assembly.

nodes.label: MCQ Quality Guidelines (4 options, no all/none of the above)
nodes.norm_label: mcq quality guidelines (4 options, no all/none of the above)

nodes.label: Two-Model Independent Zero-Shot Solve
nodes.rationale: Solving blind to the key 3x at temperature 0.7 eliminates writer self-confirmation bias; majority disagreement -> key_mismatch, inter-run disagreement -> ambiguous.

nodes.label: ADR 005: Deterministic Blueprint Rules Engine & Self-Repair Loop
nodes.norm_label: adr 005: deterministic blueprint rules engine & self-repair loop
nodes.rationale: LLMs produce rounding bugs on exact marks; rules engine verifies sum(count*marksEach)==targetMarks and repair_blueprint balances cells.

nodes.label: ADR 006: 2.5x Candidate Pool, Distractor Rationales & Grounding
nodes.norm_label: adr 006: 2.5x candidate pool, distractor rationales & grounding

nodes.label: ADR 007: Adversarial Reviewer & Vector Duplicate Detection
nodes.norm_label: adr 007: adversarial reviewer & vector duplicate detection
nodes.rationale: Item-drafting LLMs rationalize their own keys; blind solve breaks self-confirmation bias.

nodes.label: ADR 008: Multi-Version Assembly via OR-Tools CP-SAT
nodes.norm_label: adr 008: multi-version assembly via or-tools cp-sat
nodes.rationale: LLMs hallucinate totals and overlaps; CP-SAT with num_workers=1 gives deterministic OPTIMAL solutions <30ms.

nodes.label: ADR 009: Moderation Governance, RBAC Approval & Multi-Format Exports
nodes.norm_label: adr 009: moderation governance, rbac approval & multi-format exports
nodes.rationale: Accreditation bodies (ABET, AACSB, QAA) forbid lecturer self-certification; HTTP 403 enforced.
